edit_rationale.objective: Full-period field FOPR/FWPR and well WOPR/WWPR. Pressure and gas production are diagnostic; the end of history receives the same weighting as other periods.
edit_rationale.feedback_evidence: round1_oil_water_partial_comparison.json: actual simulated responses through the common day 1488 and the near-well Sw field at the same time.
edit_rationale.known_history_window: All 2891 days of observations were available. The experiment used no strict blind or holdout evaluation.
edit_rationale.inherited_permeability: Start from the round-one permeability-only input. The near-well horizontal permeability reduction was originally suggested by pressure diagnostics. Judge its retention using oil and water only; the pressure improvement is outside the score.
edit_rationale.porosity_multiplier_basis: Relative to the original porosity. The porosity in the parent round1_k_only is the same as the baseline.
edit_rationale.permeability_multiplier_basis: Relative to parent round1_k_only and applied on top of its existing edits. These are additional multipliers, rather than totals relative to the original field.
edit_rationale.p14_rationale: On day 1488 the water rate was 199.82 m3/day against 862.36 observed. Water was already present in eight lower completion cells. Test the fraction of lower-zone inflow and vertical water propagation. First water arrival preceded injection.
edit_rationale.p15_rationale: On day 1488 the water rate was 45.96 m3/day against 318.78 observed. Sw rose mainly in three lower completion cells. Increase lower-zone horizontal inflow capacity and vertical connectivity and reduce hydrocarbon-bearing pore volume along the path.
edit_rationale.p16_rationale: On day 1488 the water rate was 18.91 m3/day against 252.49 observed. Sw at the deepest completion was approximately 0.326. The previous minimum-resistance path to any completion missed the deepest water-entry layer. The discrete path to the deepest completion has four cells, all in layer K219. Increase permeability along that path and Kh in the lower zone.
edit_rationale.low_water_cut_well_rationale: Near day 1488 the observed P11/P12 water rates were 14.20/26.10 m3/day and the simulations gave 0.53/0.31. Modestly accelerate deep bottom-water arrival. P13 is close at this point but water rises later, so use a weaker edit and check for premature arrival over the complete history.
edit_rationale.path_type: Use shortest static paths with cost 1/T on actual positive-transmissibility connections to locate candidate regions. Evaluate them using simulated Sw and timing since the static paths are not verified dynamic streamlines.
edit_rationale.region: Use a 3D Gaussian around the bottom-water path to the deepest completion, with horizontal and vertical scales of 220 m and 30 m and zero weight beyond three scales. At wet wells, use a 20 m tanh transition over the lower 60 m and a 220 m horizontal Gaussian. Combine regions by maximum weight to avoid multiplying overlaps twice.
edit_rationale.porosity_constraints: Edit only active cells with initial Sw < 0.99 and cell pore volume > 1e-3 m3. Retain pore volume in pure-water cells.
edit_rationale.initial_composition: Retain the original normalized composition. This round makes no composition edit to fit the gas-oil ratio. Fractions still sum to one in every cell.
edit_rationale.fixed_items: Retain the well controls, liquid rate, initial pressure and Sw, temperature, EOS, SCAL, grid and simulator source.
edit_rationale.completion_criteria: Rerun all 516 intervals over 2891 days from t0. Compute the primary score after native input and report-state checks pass.

parallel_execution_note: Propose candidates using already simulated windows. The baseline and ranked candidates must each complete 2891 days under the same scoring rules.
